mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can reduce renal clearance of eslicarbazepine and its metabolites, potentially increasing drug exposure; eslicarbazepine may also affect tobramycin pharmacokinetics through renal function alterations.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly; adjust eslicarbazepine dosing if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for signs of nephrotoxicity.
